form.title: OCIA Sponsor
form.successBody: Fr. Higuera or a member of the OCIA team will be in touch before sessions begin. Watch for a copy of this form in your email.
step.what-a-sponsor-does.title: What a sponsor does
step.what-a-sponsor-does.help: Read this first. If it is not the right year for you to take this on, that is a good thing to know now.
step.what-a-sponsor-does.roleNotice.html:
Accompany

  • Attend OCIA sessions weekly.
  • Inquire about the process.
  • Check in throughout the week.

Pray

  • Worship at Sunday Mass.
  • Commit to daily personal prayer.
  • Pray with your candidate.
  • Pray for your candidate.

Witness

  • Share your experiences.
  • Model an integrated Catholic life.
  • Live the joy of the Gospel.

Believe, hope, love

  • God is alive today and working miracles today.
  • Keep a heaven-based perspective and trust in the work God is doing.
  • Love God, love your candidate, and be willing to be poured out in service to both this year.
step.what-a-sponsor-does.sessionNotice.h:
Sponsors are expected to attend all OCIA sessions and Rites with their candidates. Sessions are Thursday evenings at 6pm in the St. John the Baptist Parish Hall, Cle Elum.

Questions before you commit? Call Fr. Francisco Higuera at (509) 674-2531 ext. 5 or email Fr.higuera@yakimadiocese.org.
step.what-a-sponsor-does.commitment.labe: I understand what is being asked and I am willing to commit to it for this year.
step.eligibility.title: A few requirements
step.eligibility.help: The Church asks these of every sponsor. If you answer no to any of them, send the form anyway and we will talk it through.
step.eligibility.isConfirmedCatholic.lab: Have you been baptized and confirmed in the Catholic Church, and received First Communion?
step.eligibility.isPracticing.label: Are you currently attending Mass and living in full communion with the Church?
step.eligibility.isPracticing.help: This includes marriage being recognised by the Church, if you are married.
step.eligibility.eligibilityHelp.html: Thank you for answering honestly. This is very often something that can be resolved, and it is worth a conversation. Please send the form and Fr. Higuera will follow up with you directly.
